'''Wrendui''' was a subtle body language of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], created by their fur shifting in response to their emotional state by way of gentle ripplings. Bothan [[Spy/Legends|spies]] used mastery of this response in order to communicate covertly.

It was polite to ripple the fur when communicating with someone; some unsocial Bothans forgot to do so, and were considered "rude" by others.<ref>''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
